content: I used a piece of filament to align the heatbed, center spacer, and hole. Then popped out the filament to insert screw.

replies.content: The 2mm  allen key works here too. Guide it in from the bottom of the carriage. Place the spacer on it, then slide the heatbed on. Remove the allen key to place the screw.

content: Here, before placing the heatbed, it is probably also the time to remove the old expansion joints and place the new gen 2 ones with their expansion joint screws.
If you have installed the Gen2 heatbed spacers, keep in mind that the new center spacer is longer than the old one (new = 10mm)!
